title: Oswin, the Dread Warden Boss Guide: Coldflame, Bell Slam and +2 Weapon Set Passives
summary: Path of Exile 2 Interlude 1 optional boss guide: Oswin's axe, ice traps, Bell Slam and Profane Flame, and how the Warden's Ledger grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
description: Beat Oswin, the Dread Warden in PoE2 Wolvenhold (Interlude 1). Reach his door via Holden, dodge the coldflame and bell, and claim the Warden's Ledger for +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Oswin, the Dread Warden is the Interlude 1 Wolvenhold optional boss whose kill drops the Warden's Ledger — +2 Weapon Set Passive Points when used.
calloutDetail: Reach Wolvenhold through Holden; his door sits past a checkpoint with the lore item Elswyth's Letter, usually near a map edge.
Every ice/fire hit applies Profane Flame — a stacking Critical-Hit-risk debuff that persists the whole fight.
The +2 are Weapon Set Passive Points in the Weapon Set node, not your normal passive pool.

sections.title: Top search questions: Wolvenhold, Ledger, Profane Flame

items.question: Where is Oswin in Wolvenhold?
answer: Enter Wolvenhold from Holden in Interlude 1. Follow the border; his door is past a checkpoint holding Elswyth's Letter, often upper-right or a map edge.

items.question: What does the Warden's Ledger do?
answer: Right-clicking it grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Points, allocated in the passive tree Weapon Set node — not the normal passive pool.

items.question: What is Profane Flame?
answer: A debuff applied by his ice/fire attacks that raises your chance to be Critically Hit and stacks. It does not fade during the fight, so avoid his coldflame.

items.question: Is Oswin the Interlude finale?
answer: No. The Interlude 1 finale is Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth; Oswin is an optional side boss you can clear for the passive points.

steps.label: Enter Wolvenhold
body: Progress through Interlude 1 until you can enter Wolvenhold via Holden.

steps.label: Find the checkpoint
body: Clear around the map borders; watch for the checkpoint with the lore item Elswyth's Letter.

steps.label: Locate the boss door
body: The boss door is just past that checkpoint, often near the upper-right or a map edge.

steps.label: Activate checkpoint
body: Activate the checkpoint before opening the door.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: Oswin is a slow but wide-reaching warden who smashes a giant candelabra and wields coldflame. The arena is dotted with trap holes that glow blue before erupting into spikes, and he conjures an icy bell for a delayed slam.
The core danger is Profane Flame: every cold/fire hit stacks a Critical-Hit-risk debuff that never clears in the fight, so positioning to avoid his coldflame is more important than raw DPS.
bullets: Profane Flame stacks and persists — avoid coldflame.
Trap holes glow blue before spiking.
Bell Slam is fast; create distance when it spawns.

sections.title: The Wolvenhold Arena
paragraphs: The fight happens in a chamber laced with trap holes. Blue glows telegraph the icy spike eruptions, so keep mental note of where you are standing.
Oswin's bell appears in front of him and crashes after a delay — the radius is the danger zone, so skirt the edge of the bell circle.
bullets: Trap holes erupt after a blue glow.
Bell Slam radius is deadly — move out.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Single Continuous Fight
notes: No formal phase split, but attack frequency and combos surge below 50% HP.

attacks.name: Heavy Axe Attack
telegraph: Swings his axes at close range.
responses: Sidestep, then free-hit during his slow recovery.
notes: Slow to recover — punishes pay off.

attacks.name: Back Axe Fissure
telegraph: Fissures the ground as he turns, creating ice spikes that narrow the arena.
responses: Bait his axe attacks to shatter the spikes, then reposition.

attacks.name: Frosted Whirl (Cyclone)
telegraph: Whirls in a straight line toward you.
responses: Sidestep away from his body as he spins.
notes: Wait for the animation to end, then hit.

attacks.name: Icy Spike Traps
telegraph: Activates arena trap holes; blue glow precedes the spikes.
responses: Stay out of the blue-lit holes; use the opening to approach.

attacks.name: Ice Slam
telegraph: Infuses axes with ice, then slams to the ground creating a radius of ice spikes.
responses: Stay out of the slam radius, then close in after.

attacks.name: Bell Slam
telegraph: Conjures an icy bell in front, then crashes it for a frost explosion after a delay.
responses: The moment the bell spawns, flee its radius; it can chill/freeze.

sections.title: Reward Claim Flow — Warden's Ledger to +2 Weapon Set Passives
paragraphs: On defeat Oswin drops the Warden's Ledger on the ground.
Pick it up and right-click to use it. It grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Points, allocated in the passive tree Weapon Set node.
bullets: Defeat Oswin -> Ledger drops on the ground.
Right-click to use -> +2 Weapon Set Passive Points.
One-time; shown in the Weapon Set node.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Oswin punishes melee that over-commits; his slow heavies give a free-hit window, but his quick AOE blasts (especially Bell Slam) favor ranged kite. Ice Resistance lowers the constant Cold tax.
Because Profane Flame stacks and never fades, the priority is dodging coldflame over trading blows — a patient ranged or Hit-and-run build wins cleanly.
bullets: Ice Resist eases the Cold tax.
Dodge coldflame to limit Profane Flame.

entries.question: Warden's Ledger points did not show up
summary: Players report the 2 points missing after use.
editorialAnalysis: The +2 are Weapon Set Passive Points in the Weapon Set node, not the normal pool — players often look in the wrong place.
officialAnswer: The Warden's Ledger grants +2 Weapon Set Passive Points, allocated in the passive tree Weapon Set node.

entries.question: Why do I keep getting crit after Oswin
summary: Players report unexpected Critical Hits during the fight.
editorialAnalysis: Profane Flame from his coldflame stack increases Crit-Hit chance and does not fade; dodging the coldflame is the fix.
officialAnswer: Profane Flame raises Critical Hit chance and stacks from his ice/fire attacks.

directAnswer: Enter Wolvenhold via Holden, clear the borders, and look for the checkpoint with Elswyth's Letter; his door is just past it, often near a map edge.
The bell spawns fast. The instant it appears, flee its radius — it can chill or freeze you inside.

problems.symptom: No Weapon Set points after the fight
directAnswer: The Ledger drops on the ground and must be picked up AND right-clicked. The +2 go to the Weapon Set node, not your normal pool.
